bait_content.title: I/O Conflict: Cache Lock Contention
bait_content.body: A stale lock on the browser disk cache was detected following a background component update. Pending writes cannot be committed reliably while the lock is held, which may cause stalled requests or corrupted entries. To restore normal operation, release orphaned file handles and rebuild the cache index. Open tabs will reload and active downloads may pause briefly.
